candidates.evidence: The source states that the heal does not work on undead ('this heal does not work on undead'), but the target translates it as '对不死族有效' (effective on undead), which directly reverses the polarity.
The source uses the verb 'fry' ('fry your enemies brain'), which means to burn or scorch, but the translation incorrectly renders it as '封锁' (block/lock).

The source specifies 'one of the target's sustained talents will be deactivated', but the translation uses '你的' (your), incorrectly applying the deactivation to the player's sustained talents instead of the target's.

The source states 'Increases Strength and Dexterity by %d%% of your Willpower and Cunning, respectively', mapping Willpower to Strength and Cunning to Dexterity. The translation reverses the target attributes as '敏捷和力量' (Dexterity and Strength), erroneously pairing Willpower with Dexterity and Cunning with Strength.
The source specifies flat damage ('dealing %d acid damage'), but the translation adds an extraneous percent sign ('%d%% 酸性伤害'), converting flat damage into percentage damage.

candidates.target_span: 减少 %d 酸性和枯萎抗性
candidates.correction: 减少 %d%% 酸性和枯萎抗性
candidates.evidence: The source specifies resistance reduction as a percentage ('by %d%%'), but the translation omits the percent sign, stating '减少 %d'.
The source states that creatures 'are knocked away from you', but the translation states '并被击退至靠近你的方向' (knocked towards you), reversing the direction of the knockback.
The source specifies a single target ('your foe'), but the translation uses '所有敌人' (all enemies), erroneously broadening the target scope from a single enemy to all enemies.
